_about: MOCHI e (Honda e): its five screens are one material (ScreenTexture) with their own pictures (1024 px): the driver's display (top: a battery ring, 'Battery Remains 95%', the car in it), the EV menu and the charging / media page (the two middle screens across the dash). The pictures are kept (the owner: keep the models' art) and made live where they show a reading: the battery's percentage in the ring and on the charging page; the empty dark sides of the driver's display get the speed (left), the gear and the range (right), the clock and the lamps along the bottom. Pixels of that texture; the screens glow at night.
